page.content:
Biotech giant Kazuya uses as a rival throne to the Zaibatsu.

How G Corporation connects

  • Character: Kazuya Mishima — Kazuya rebuilt his power as the hidden head of G Corporation.
  • Faction: Mishima Zaibatsu — G Corporation is Kazuya's corporate rival to the Mishima Zaibatsu.
  • Character: Steve Fox — Steve Fox's past is a genetic program tied to Mishima and G Corporation labs.

What is G Corporation?

G Corporation is the biotech firm that recovered Kazuya's body after Tekken 2 and later became his corporate army against Jin's Mishima Zaibatsu.

Key threads lead to Kazuya Mishima, Mishima Zaibatsu and Steve Fox.
